sources.entry: HireDraftAI - AI-assisted resumes and cover letters with free anonymous tools for reviewing keywords and planning job applications. #freemium #writing

summary.name: HireDraftAI
summary.one_liner: An AI job-application tool that turns a saved resume plus a pasted job description into a tailored CV, matching cover letter, ATS feedback, and application record.
use_cases: tailoring a CV to a specific job posting
writing a matching cover letter quickly
checking resume keywords against a job description
tracking job applications in one place
preparing many applications during an active job search
summary.what_it_does: HireDraftAI takes one saved resume profile and a pasted job description and generates a role-specific CV, a matching cover letter, and ATS guidance. The page says the candidate's employers, dates, qualifications and achievements stay fixed while the emphasis, language and selected evidence change per job. Outputs are editable and PDF-ready. Each run also saves an application record. The page says the process takes under one minute. The ATS guidance lists matched keywords and gaps with suggested next edits.
notable: Keeps employers, dates and qualifications fixed while tailoring wording and emphasis per job
Generates CV, cover letter, ATS guidance and a saved application record together
Free tier of 10 AI generations per month with no credit card required
Pro plan offers weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly billing with unlimited generation subject to fair use
caveats: Free tier is limited to 10 generations per month
Pro plan pricing amounts are not shown on the page; unlimited use is subject to fair use
Listing describes free anonymous tools for keyword review, but the page itself does not mention them
